goal: Prevent employee-facing production runtime paths from completing tasks or sending replies with fake, mock, demo, sample, placeholder, stub, or fabricated data.

acceptance_criteria.description: A static scanner checks only production runtime paths for high-confidence fake-data completion and reply patterns while excluding tests, docs, UI assets, generated/runtime data, and scanner fixtures.
Focused tests prove the scanner flags fake employee-facing completions or replies and ignores test, docs, UI, and ordinary placeholder noise.
The no_fake_data_runtime contract stays valid under the shared harness contract validator and lists its verification commands.
Harness runtime completion blocks employee-facing strict-source tasks without concrete result provenance while allowing generic tasks and cited strict completions.
Employee-facing pet assistant task views never seed, show, or complete non-production task data; empty states must disclose missing real task sources.
Hermes deep-runtime completed callbacks cannot complete strict-source tasks without concrete result provenance.
Employee-facing /task done reports Harness lifecycle or source-provenance completion blocks instead of crashing, completing the task, or closing linked AI Inbox items.

Employee onboarding cannot mark employees completed or invited from placeholder invite links, failed/invalid invite API results, or undelivered result cards; only a delivered real invite link or confirmed auto-invite success completes the invite step.
